season.evidence: Stored Jun-Aug kept. WebSearch: a climbing-guide page suggests May at the earliest with snow lingering in the bowl until at least June; a May 2006 report found the summit snow-covered and the return ford swollen by snowmelt; the trail stretch to Elip Creek is passable most of the year but fords can be impassable in rainy months. Logged ascents are sparse (Mar 1, May 2, Aug 2, Sep 1, Oct 1).

notes: No qualifying track; the only August ascent ('North side') has no GPS track.
